title: "Glossary"
description: "Project-specific terms used in message-contracts, each tied to its source definition."

# Glossary

**Correlation ID.** A UUID generated by the originating cron run that links messages in one workflow ([src/correlation.ts:L4-L8](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/correlation.ts#L4-L8)).

**CorrelationIdCarrier.** An interface with an optional `correlation_id` field, kept optional for backward compatibility ([src/correlation.ts:L10-L18](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/correlation.ts#L10-L18)).

**isCorrelationId.** A type guard that checks whether an untrusted value matches the UUID pattern ([src/correlation.ts:L23-L26](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/correlation.ts#L23-L26)).

**Exchange configuration.** A constant object with name, type, durable flag, and routing keys, such as `PingExchange` ([src/exchanges.ts:L24-L32](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/exchanges.ts#L24-L32)).

**Routing key.** The string a publisher uses to route a message through an exchange, such as `design.terminal` ([src/exchanges.ts:L200-L201](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/exchanges.ts#L200-L201)).

**Event metadata.** A constant that bundles an exchange, routing keys, and a description for one domain ([src/cron/events.ts:L43-L47](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/cron/events.ts#L43-L47)).

**Terminal receipt.** A durable record published after a lifecycle state is recorded, such as Dev Inbox design states ([src/dev-inbox/events.ts:L10-L15](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/dev-inbox/events.ts#L10-L15)).

**Cron target.** A registry entry with a label, exchange, and routing key for a publishable job ([src/cron-targets.ts:L21-L25](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/cron-targets.ts#L21-L25)).

**Tick.** A clock signal that starts one Spanish lesson or session ([src/spanish/events.ts:L29-L32](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/spanish/events.ts#L29-L32)).

**Vocabulary seed command and result.** The requested and resolved message pair in the Spanish vocabulary pipeline ([src/spanish/vocabulary-seed-events.ts:L25](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/spanish/vocabulary-seed-events.ts#L25), [L52](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/spanish/vocabulary-seed-events.ts#L52)).

**Dispatch config.** Per-role provider and model settings, published after a committed write ([src/agency/events.ts:L165-L184](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/agency/events.ts#L165-L184)).

**Corpus fingerprint.** A hash of the authoritative Logos corpus, used to detect changes ([src/logos/events.ts:L110-L123](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/logos/events.ts#L110-L123)).

**Evidence fingerprint.** A stable hash used for follow-up deduplication of QA probe runs ([src/qa/probes-events.ts:L17-L18](https://github.com/Jeffrey-Keyser/message-contracts/blob/95d5d12e4d2de5407329ffd5a5406e470b0ec0f8/src/qa/probes-events.ts#L17-L18)).
